home.headline: Talk to verified experts near you
home.verifiedNote: Every expert is ID and certificate verified by our team.
home.workerSoon: Worker registration (Aadhaar + certificates) is coming in the next update.

browse.emptyBody: We're onboarding verified experts near {{place}}. Check back soon or try another area.

tagline.doctor: Consult doctors by chat, voice or video

settings.notifyNote: Choose which alerts come to your phone. Everything also shows in the 🔔 bell.

askBody.worker: Get an alert with sound when a client requests you, even when Meiyiyal is closed.
askBody.client: Get an alert when your doctor, lawyer or engineer replies or calls you.
askBody.admin: Get an alert when a payout or verification needs your review.

push.installTitle: Add Meiyiyal to your Home Screen
push.installBody: On iPhone, alerts work only in the Home Screen app (iOS 16.4 or later).
push.installStep1: In Safari, tap the Share button
push.installStep3: Open Meiyiyal from the new icon and turn on alerts
push.deniedHint: Alerts are blocked for Meiyiyal in this browser. Allow them in your browser or phone settings, then come back.
push.unsupported: This browser can't show alerts. Use Chrome on Android, or the Home Screen app on iPhone.
push.noKey: Alerts are not set up on this server yet.
push.on: Alerts are on for this device
push.statusOff: Alerts are off for this device
push.offBanner: Alerts are off. You may miss requests when the app is closed.
push.turnedOff: Alerts turned off for this device
push.quietHint: During these hours alerts wait and come as one summary in the morning. New requests and calls still ring while you are online.
push.alwaysNote: Safety and account notices (account paused, application not approved, payout failed) always come.
push.mockNote: Test mode: alerts are saved here but not sent to phones.

worker.pitch: Earn by consulting online. Verify Aadhaar and your certificates once — approval within 24 hours.
worker.aadhaarWhy: We verify your identity with Aadhaar OTP. Only the last 4 digits are stored.
worker.otpSentTo: OTP sent to the mobile linked with {{masked}}
worker.qrWhy: Scan the QR on your Aadhaar card or e-Aadhaar PDF. We check UIDAI's signature and keep only the last 4 digits. The QR is deleted 30 days after a decision.
worker.selfieWhy: We'll ask you to do 3 quick actions in front of the camera. The raw frames are private and deleted 30 days after a decision. A separate photo is your public profile photo only if you agree.
worker.livenessDid: I did this action in the photo
worker.selfieConsent: I agree this photo can be shown on my public profile. My Aadhaar photo is never public.
worker.docsNote: PDF or photo, up to 10 MB. Documents are private and seen only by our verification team.

statusHint.draft: Finish the remaining steps to submit.
statusHint.needs_info: Update the details below and resubmit.
statusHint.approved: You can go online and receive requests.
statusHint.rejected: Contact support if you think this is a mistake.

worker.onlineHint: Users nearby can find and request you.

err.type: Use a PDF or a photo (JPG, PNG or WebP).

worker.lockedNote: Your profession is locked after registration. You can still change your field within it.
worker.appealNote: Why should this be reviewed again?
worker.qrScanning: Point the camera at the large QR on your Aadhaar. Hold steady.
worker.qrFound: QR read. Check it below and continue.
worker.qrNoCamera: Camera not available. Upload a photo of the QR or paste its text.
worker.qrImageFail: Couldn't find a QR in that photo. Try a sharper, well-lit photo.
worker.qrImagePick: Choose a photo of the QR
worker.liveExpired: That took too long. Start again.
worker.liveNoCamera: No camera found. You can upload a photo instead — a reviewer will check it by hand, which takes longer.
worker.livePortrait: This photo will be your profile picture

reject.identity: Your Aadhaar QR could not be confirmed.
reject.identity_bad_signature: The Aadhaar QR is not genuine or was changed (its UIDAI signature does not match).
reject.identity_last4: The Aadhaar QR belongs to a different Aadhaar number than the one you verified with OTP.
reject.identity_bad_uid: The Aadhaar number in the QR is not valid.
reject.identity_bad_reference: The Aadhaar QR could not be read correctly.
reject.registry: Your council registration could not be confirmed.
reject.registry_suspended: The council register shows this registration as suspended, removed or expired.
reject.duplicates: These details are already used by another account.
reject.duplicates_active: This council number or Aadhaar is already used by another active professional on Meiyiyal.
reject.duplicates_banned: This council number or Aadhaar belongs to an account that was blocked or rejected.
reject.face: Your selfie could not be matched.
reject.face_liveness_static: The live check looked like a photo or screen, not a live person.
reject.face_mismatch: Your selfie does not match the photo on your Aadhaar.
reject.risk: Too many checks failed to approve this automatically.
reject.risk_high: Too many checks failed to approve this automatically.

rejectHint.generic: You can appeal below within 30 days. A different admin will review it.
rejectHint.identity: Download a fresh e-Aadhaar from the UIDAI website or mAadhaar and scan its QR, then appeal.
rejectHint.registry: Check your registration number and your council status, then appeal with a current council certificate.
rejectHint.duplicates: If this is your number and someone else is using it, appeal and tell us; we will look into it.
rejectHint.face: Do the live selfie again in good light, facing the camera alone, then appeal.
rejectHint.risk: Appeal with clearer documents; a person will review everything.
